result.stderr:
Usage: avalonia-spy-mcp                          (lazy mode, MCP ready, no app)
       avalonia-spy-mcp --launch <exe>            (launch app, auto-connect)
       avalonia-spy-mcp --launch <exe> --launch-args <args>
       avalonia-spy-mcp --listen <port>           (connect to running app)

In lazy mode (no args), the MCP server starts immediately and waits for the
'launch-app' tool to start a target app at runtime.

Options:
  --launch <exe>       Launch the target application
  --launch-args <args> Arguments to pass to the target app
  --listen <port>      Connect to an already-running app
  --version, -v        Show version
  --help, -h           Show this help
